summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature verification (iteration 3). All four new features validated on mobile viewport 390x844: (1) Home header renders history/settings(cog)/theme buttons; CAPTURE CADENCE row defaults to 'Every 5s'. (2) Settings modal opens via settings-button, selecting cadence-option-2s updates cadence-row to 'Every 2s' and persists across page reload; tapping cadence-row also opens settings. (3) Languages picker: starring ja+fr shows 'FAVORITES' section header (section-fav) with 'ALL LANGUAGES' below (section-all); unstar removes from favorites; search filters (typing 'span' still shows language-row-es); selecting language-row-es returns Home showing 'Spanish'; favorites persist across reopen + reload. (4) History copy: seeded 2 translations, tapping a history-item-<id> card shows 'copied-toast' with text 'Copied to clipboard', clipboard verified via navigator.clipboard.readText() -> 'Hello world', toast auto-hides after ~1.5-2s; 'Tap to copy' hint visible. Regression: history-clear-button works (history-empty shown after clear), languages-close-button returns home, no console errors. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues: none. Native pin-overlay lock / manual refresh live in Kotlin and were skipped per request.
critical_code_review_comments: history.tsx uses expo-clipboard (correct, expo-av not used). No deprecated packages spotted in the changed files.
prefs.ts is small, focused, and correctly uses AsyncStorage keys 'capture-cadence' and 'fav-langs' as specified.
settings.tsx and languages.tsx use SafeArea via useSafeAreaInsets() (no legacy SafeAreaView from 'react-native'), consistent with existing screens.
Copy flow correctly: cancels previous toast timer on repeat taps, plays haptic on success, uses Animated + pointerEvents='none' so toast never blocks further interaction — good UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (22/22 assertions passed; theme-toggle screenshot verified visually — programmatic body-bg check returned false-negative because RN Web keeps document.body transparent, not a real bug)

seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 rows into MongoDB collection 'translations' (Japanese -> Hello world, French -> Hello the world) to enable history copy testing. Cleared during regression via /api/history DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: History uses MongoDB collection 'translations' (not 'history') — seed there. Backend URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Clipboard reads require context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']). Theme-change verification via document.body backgroundColor doesn't work on RN Web (transparent); check an inner element style or the theme-toggle icon name instead. Native pin-lock and manual refresh are Kotlin-only, skip in web preview.
rca_of_issue: No unresolved issues. All new features (favorite languages, capture cadence + persistence, copy-to-clipboard with toast) work end-to-end.
